theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lura_lintegral_image_eq_tsum_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid d)) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P), ContinuousOn G M → InjOn G M → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i)) → (∀ i, A i ⊆ M) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → μHE[m] (G '' (M \ ⋃ i, A i)) = 0 → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ w in G '' M, g w ∂μHE[m] = ∑' i, ∫⁻ w in G '' A i, g w ∂μHE[m]
